title: Construction Site with Crane & Concrete Pillars, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A stark black and white photograph capturing an active industrial construction site from the mid-20th century. Tall reinforced concrete columns stand upright alongside a massive concrete retaining wall, with a large lattice-boom crane anchored in the midground against a cloudy sky. The image highlights post-WWII infrastructure growth and modern commercial building techniques.
